Tooltip.description: A tooltip on UI SDK: a short label on hover or focus; it names or describes its trigger, and Escape closes it.

Root.description: Holds the open state and the delays; it renders no element of its own.

type.description: label: the tooltip names its trigger. description: it adds a hint. Unset, it names a trigger with no name of its own.

delay.description: Milliseconds the pointer rests on the trigger before the tooltip opens; UI SDK's default is 600.

closeDelay.description: Milliseconds before it closes once the pointer leaves; UI SDK's default is 0.

disabled.description: Stops the tooltip from opening; the trigger keeps working.

open.description: Controls the open state; pair it with onOpenChange.

onOpenChange.description: Called with the next open state whenever the tooltip asks to open or close.

Trigger.description: The element the tooltip names or describes; it renders a kit Button unless render gives another element.

variant.description: The Button variant; unset, it is the Button default, secondary.

size.description: The Button size; unset, it is the Button default, m.

render.description: Another element to trigger with, in place of the kit Button, such as an IconButton.

Popup.description: The label, in the browser's top layer while open; it opens above the trigger and flips when there is no room.

container.description: The element, or a ref to it, the label mounts into instead of in place. It still opens in the top layer.

side.description: The trigger's side the label opens on; unset, top. It flips when there is no room.

align.description: The label's alignment along that side; unset, center.

sideOffset.description: Extra px on top of the kit's CSS offset between the trigger and the label.

collisionPadding.description: Kit-set: the 8px gap the label keeps from the window's edges, the Dialog's gutter.

children.description: The label: short plain text. Never a link or a button; the label cannot take focus.

useWhen: A short label for a control that shows only an icon.
A one-line hint on a control that has a visible name.

avoidWhen.text: The content has a link, a button or more than a sentence.
The message matters on touch screens, which have no hover.

a11y: Keep the label to plain text; a tooltip cannot take focus.
Put nothing in a tooltip that a touch user needs: a plain tap only presses the trigger.
On an icon-only trigger, set the Root's type to label so the tooltip is its name.
